mapper.select: SELECT v.rule_id ruleId,v.rule_version_id ruleVersionId,r.rule_code ruleCode,r.rule_name ruleName, v.version_no versionNo,v.state,v.created_by creatorUserId,v.approved_by approvedBy, v.version,v.content_sha256 contentSha256 FROM prm_rule_version v JOIN prm_rule r ON r.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND r.rule_id=v.rule_id WHERE v.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND v.rule_id=#{ruleId} AND v.rule_version_id=#{ruleVersionId}
mapper.update: UPDATE prm_rule_version SET state=#{toState},version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), approved_by=CASE WHEN #{toState}='APPROVED' THEN #{actorUserId} ELSE approved_by END, approved_at=CASE WHEN #{toState}='APPROVED' THEN #{at} ELSE approved_at END, published_at=CASE WHEN #{toState}='PUBLISHED' THEN #{at} ELSE published_at END, paused_at=CASE WHEN #{toState}='PAUSED' THEN #{at} ELSE paused_at END WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND rule_id=#{ruleId} AND rule_version_id=#{ruleVersionId} AND state=#{fromState} AND version=#{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT v.rule_version_id ruleVersionId,v.rule_type ruleType,v.priority,v.stack_mode stackMode, v.exclusive_group exclusiveGroup,v.effective_from effectiveFrom,v.effective_to effectiveTo, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(s.dimension_type,':',s.dimension_value) ORDER BY s.dimension_type,s.dimension_value SEPARATOR '|') FROM prm_rule_scope s WHERE s.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND s.rule_version_id=v.rule_version_id) scopeTokens, b.amount_minor amountMinor,b.discount_rate discountRate,b.nth_value nthValue, b.threshold_minor thresholdMinor,b.threshold_quantity thresholdQuantity, b.bundle_price_minor bundlePriceMinor,CAST(b.bundle_components_json AS CHAR) bundleComponentsJson FROM prm_rule_version v JOIN prm_rule_benefit b ON b.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND b.rule_version_id=v.rule_version_id WHERE v.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND v.state='PUBLISHED' AND v.effective_from<=#{at} AND (v.effective_to IS NULL OR v.effective_to>#{at}) ORDER BY v.priority DESC,v.rule_version_id ASC

SELECT v.rule_version_id ruleVersionId,v.rule_type ruleType,v.priority,v.stack_mode stackMode, v.exclusive_group exclusiveGroup,v.effective_from effectiveFrom,v.effective_to effectiveTo, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(s.dimension_type,':',s.dimension_value) ORDER BY s.dimension_type,s.dimension_value SEPARATOR '|') FROM prm_rule_scope s WHERE s.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND s.rule_version_id=v.rule_version_id) scopeTokens, b.amount_minor amountMinor,b.discount_rate discountRate,b.nth_value nthValue, b.threshold_minor thresholdMinor,b.threshold_quantity thresholdQuantity, b.bundle_price_minor bundlePriceMinor,CAST(b.bundle_components_json AS CHAR) bundleComponentsJson FROM prm_rule_version v JOIN prm_rule_benefit b ON b.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND b.rule_version_id=v.rule_version_id WHERE v.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND v.rule_version_id=#{ruleVersionId}

SELECT request_sha256 requestSha256,aggregate_id aggregateId,result_sha256 resultSha256, CAST(result_json AS CHAR) resultJson FROM prm_command_result WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND command_type=#{commandType} AND idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey}

SELECT source_line_id sourceLineId,line_no lineNo,sku_id skuId,quantity, gross_amount_minor grossAmountMinor, discount_amount_minor discountAmountMinor,payable_amount_minor payableAmountMinor FROM prm_quote_line WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND quote_id=#{quoteId} ORDER BY line_no

SELECT quote_id quoteId,store_id storeId,terminal_id terminalId,business_time businessTime,currency, request_sha256 requestSha256,result_sha256 resultSha256,engine_version engineVersion, package_version packageVersion,gross_amount_minor grossAmountMinor, discount_amount_minor discountAmountMinor,payable_amount_minor payableAmountMinor FROM prm_quote WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND quote_id=#{quoteId}

SELECT quote_id quoteId,store_id storeId,terminal_id terminalId,business_time businessTime,currency, request_sha256 requestSha256,result_sha256 resultSha256,engine_version engineVersion, package_version packageVersion,gross_amount_minor grossAmountMinor, discount_amount_minor discountAmountMinor,payable_amount_minor payableAmountMinor FROM prm_quote WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND quote_id=#{quoteId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT source_line_id sourceLineId,source_type sourceType,source_id sourceId, calculation_stage calculationStage,amount_minor amountMinor, explanation_code explanationCode,applied_flag appliedFlag,ordinal_no ordinalNo FROM prm_adjustment WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND quote_id=#{quoteId} ORDER BY ordinal_no ASC

SELECT v.config_version_id policyVersionId,v.content_sha256 contentSha256, CAST(v.content_json AS CHAR) contentJson FROM jsh_config_binding b JOIN jsh_config_template t ON t.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND t.template_id=b.template_id JOIN jsh_config_template_version v ON v.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND v.template_id=b.template_id AND v.config_version_id=b.current_version_id WHERE b.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND t.template_code='PROMOTION_MANUAL_AUTHORITY' AND t.status='ACTIVE' AND v.state='PUBLISHED' AND ((b.target_type='STORE' AND b.target_id=#{storeId}) OR (b.target_type='TENANT' AND b.target_id IS NULL)) ORDER BY CASE WHEN b.target_type='STORE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,b.binding_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT authorization_id authorizationId,event_sequence eventSequence,state,quote_id quoteId, store_id storeId,terminal_id terminalId,action_type actionType,source_line_id sourceLineId, amount_or_rate amountOrRate,payment_method paymentMethod,before_fingerprint beforeFingerprint, preview_fingerprint previewFingerprint,incremental_discount_minor incrementalDiscountMinor, policy_version_id policyVersionId,policy_sha256 policySha256, without_approval_minor withoutApprovalMinor,with_approval_minor withApprovalMinor, minimum_line_payable_minor minimumLinePayableMinor,maximum_rounding_minor maximumRoundingMinor, CAST(rounding_multiples_json AS CHAR) roundingMultiplesJson,operator_user_id operatorUserId, approver_user_id approverUserId,business_date businessDate,CAST(result_json AS CHAR) resultJson, result_sha256 resultSha256 FROM prm_manual_price_audit e WHERE e.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND e.quote_id=#{quoteId} AND e.state='PENDING_APPROVAL' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prm_manual_price_audit later WHERE later.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND later.authorization_id=e.authorization_id AND later.event_sequence>e.event_sequence) ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC,e.authorization_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT authorization_id authorizationId,event_sequence eventSequence,state,quote_id quoteId, store_id storeId,terminal_id terminalId,action_type actionType,source_line_id sourceLineId, amount_or_rate amountOrRate,payment_method paymentMethod,before_fingerprint beforeFingerprint, preview_fingerprint previewFingerprint,incremental_discount_minor incrementalDiscountMinor, policy_version_id policyVersionId,policy_sha256 policySha256, without_approval_minor withoutApprovalMinor,with_approval_minor withApprovalMinor, minimum_line_payable_minor minimumLinePayableMinor,maximum_rounding_minor maximumRoundingMinor, CAST(rounding_multiples_json AS CHAR) roundingMultiplesJson,operator_user_id operatorUserId, approver_user_id approverUserId,business_date businessDate,CAST(result_json AS CHAR) resultJson, result_sha256 resultSha256 FROM prm_manual_price_audit WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND quote_id=#{quoteId} AND state='APPLIED' ORDER BY occurred_at DESC,authorization_id DESC,event_sequence DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT authorization_id authorizationId,event_sequence eventSequence,state,quote_id quoteId, store_id storeId,terminal_id terminalId,action_type actionType,source_line_id sourceLineId, amount_or_rate amountOrRate,payment_method paymentMethod,before_fingerprint beforeFingerprint, preview_fingerprint previewFingerprint,incremental_discount_minor incrementalDiscountMinor, policy_version_id policyVersionId,policy_sha256 policySha256, without_approval_minor withoutApprovalMinor,with_approval_minor withApprovalMinor, minimum_line_payable_minor minimumLinePayableMinor,maximum_rounding_minor maximumRoundingMinor, CAST(rounding_multiples_json AS CHAR) roundingMultiplesJson,operator_user_id operatorUserId, approver_user_id approverUserId,business_date businessDate,CAST(result_json AS CHAR) resultJson, result_sha256 resultSha256 FROM prm_manual_price_audit WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND quote_id=#{quoteId} AND state='APPLIED' ORDER BY occurred_at ASC,authorization_id ASC,event_sequence ASC

SELECT authorization_id authorizationId,event_sequence eventSequence,state,quote_id quoteId, store_id storeId,terminal_id terminalId,action_type actionType,source_line_id sourceLineId, amount_or_rate amountOrRate,payment_method paymentMethod,before_fingerprint beforeFingerprint, preview_fingerprint previewFingerprint,incremental_discount_minor incrementalDiscountMinor, policy_version_id policyVersionId,policy_sha256 policySha256, without_approval_minor withoutApprovalMinor,with_approval_minor withApprovalMinor, minimum_line_payable_minor minimumLinePayableMinor,maximum_rounding_minor maximumRoundingMinor, CAST(rounding_multiples_json AS CHAR) roundingMultiplesJson,operator_user_id operatorUserId, approver_user_id approverUserId,business_date businessDate,CAST(result_json AS CHAR) resultJson, result_sha256 resultSha256 FROM prm_manual_price_audit WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND authorization_id=#{authorizationId} ORDER BY event_sequence DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO prm_manual_price_audit(manual_event_id,tenant_id,authorization_id,event_sequence,state, command_id,request_sha256,quote_id,store_id,terminal_id,action_type,source_line_id,amount_or_rate, payment_method,before_fingerprint,preview_fingerprint,incremental_discount_minor,policy_version_id, policy_sha256,without_approval_minor,with_approval_minor,minimum_line_payable_minor, maximum_rounding_minor,rounding_multiples_json,reason_code,reason_text,operator_user_id, approver_user_id,business_date,correlation_id,result_json,result_sha256,occurred_at) VALUES(#{eventId},#{tenantId},#{authorizationId},#{eventSequence},#{state},#{commandId},#{requestSha256}, #{quoteId},#{storeId},#{terminalId},#{actionType},#{sourceLineId},#{amountOrRate},#{paymentMethod}, #{beforeFingerprint},#{previewFingerprint},#{incrementalDiscountMinor},#{policyVersionId},#{policySha256}, #{withoutApprovalMinor},#{withApprovalMinor},#{minimumLinePayableMinor},#{maximumRoundingMinor}, CAST(#{roundingMultiplesJson} AS JSON),#{reasonCode},#{reasonText},#{operatorUserId},#{approverUserId}, #{businessDate},#{correlationId},CAST(#{resultJson} AS JSON),#{resultSha256},#{occurredAt})
mapper.select: SELECT v.rule_version_id ruleVersionId,v.rule_type ruleType,v.priority,v.stack_mode stackMode, v.exclusive_group exclusiveGroup,v.effective_from effectiveFrom,v.effective_to effectiveTo, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(s.dimension_type,':',s.dimension_value) ORDER BY s.dimension_type,s.dimension_value SEPARATOR '|') FROM prm_rule_scope s WHERE s.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND s.rule_version_id=v.rule_version_id) scopeTokens, b.amount_minor amountMinor,b.discount_rate discountRate,b.nth_value nthValue, b.threshold_minor thresholdMinor,b.threshold_quantity thresholdQuantity, b.bundle_price_minor bundlePriceMinor,CAST(b.bundle_components_json AS CHAR) bundleComponentsJson FROM prm_rule_version v JOIN prm_rule_benefit b ON b.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND b.rule_version_id=v.rule_version_id WHERE v.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND v.state='PUBLISHED' AND v.effective_from<#{windowEnd} AND (v.effective_to IS NULL OR v.effective_to>#{windowStart}) AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prm_rule_scope s WHERE s.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND s.rule_version_id=v.rule_version_id AND s.dimension_type='STORE') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prm_rule_scope s WHERE s.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND s.rule_version_id=v.rule_version_id AND s.dimension_type='STORE' AND s.dimension_value=CAST(#{storeId} AS CHAR))) ORDER BY v.priority DESC,v.rule_version_id ASC

SELECT package_id packageId,store_id storeId,package_version packageVersion,previous_version previousVersion, payload_sha256 payloadSha256,signing_key_id signingKeyId,object_key objectKey, generated_at generatedAt,expires_at expiresAt FROM prm_rule_package WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND store_id=#{storeId} ORDER BY package_version DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT package_id packageId,store_id storeId,package_version packageVersion,previous_version previousVersion, payload_sha256 payloadSha256,signing_key_id signingKeyId,object_key objectKey, generated_at generatedAt,expires_at expiresAt FROM prm_rule_package WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND store_id=#{storeId} AND package_version=#{packageVersion}

SELECT v.rule_version_id ruleVersionId,v.rule_type ruleType,v.priority,v.stack_mode stackMode, v.exclusive_group exclusiveGroup,v.effective_from effectiveFrom,v.effective_to effectiveTo, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(s.dimension_type,':',s.dimension_value) ORDER BY s.dimension_type,s.dimension_value SEPARATOR '|') FROM prm_rule_scope s WHERE s.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND s.rule_version_id=v.rule_version_id) scopeTokens, b.amount_minor amountMinor,b.discount_rate discountRate,b.nth_value nthValue, b.threshold_minor thresholdMinor,b.threshold_quantity thresholdQuantity, b.bundle_price_minor bundlePriceMinor,CAST(b.bundle_components_json AS CHAR) bundleComponentsJson FROM prm_rule_package p JOIN prm_rule_package_item i ON i.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND i.package_id=p.package_id AND i.store_id=p.store_id AND i.package_version=p.package_version JOIN prm_rule_version v ON v.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND v.rule_version_id=i.rule_version_id JOIN prm_rule_benefit b ON b.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND b.rule_version_id=v.rule_version_id WHERE p.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND p.store_id=#{storeId} AND p.package_version=#{packageVersion} AND i.rule_content_sha256=v.content_sha256 AND p.state IN ('AVAILABLE','ACTIVE','RETIRED') ORDER BY i.ordinal_no ASC
